description: Deathdealer's Spaulders Level 60 Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest. Requirements: - Qiraji Bindings of Command - Idol of the Sun x 2 - Silver Scarab x 5 - Clay Scarab x 5 - Brood of Nozdormu:
name: Deathdealer's Spaulders
